evals.prompt: I run a customer support bot on WhatsApp through 360dialog. I heard phone numbers are going away because of the new username thing. Our sandbox runs at http://localhost:8000. Can you set up a test that shows me exactly what my webhooks will look like when a user who adopted a username messages me, and tell me what I need to change in my code? Also show me what changes if that same user is already in my contact book.
evals.expected_output: Creates a sandbox key, configures GA + username user, triggers a user-initiated inbound, shows the BSUID-only webhook (from_user_id/user_id/username present, from/wa_id absent), then flips in_contact_book and shows the phone reappearing; explains code must key on from_user_id and treat phone as optional.

evals.prompt: my otp template keeps failing with error 131062 when we send login codes and I don't get why. we're testing against the username sandbox at http://localhost:8000. can you reproduce it and tell me the fix?
evals.expected_output: Explains 131062 = auth-flavored template addressed to a BSUID; reproduces it in the sandbox (auth template + BSUID recipient), shows the same template succeeding by phone, prescribes routing auth flows phone-only (or recovering the phone first).

evals.prompt: We store all our WhatsApp customers by phone number. If a customer hides their number behind a username, is there any way to get it back? walk me through testing that whole flow end to end on our sandbox (http://localhost:8000)
evals.expected_output: Demonstrates the REQUEST_CONTACT_INFO recovery flow: BSUID-only state first, sends the interactive/template (button text exactly 'Share Contact Info'), simulated user taps, contacts webhook with origin=contact_request and no vCard, phone visible in subsequent webhooks; explains contact book/cache effects.
